import org.leanbridge.nestedcheckedrecords.kotlin.*
fun produceOptionNull() = Api.produceOption(java.math.BigInteger.ONE)
fun produceArrayNull() = Api.produceArray(java.math.BigInteger.ONE)
fun echoArrayNull() = Api.echoArray(arrayOf(Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE)))
fun firstNull() = Api.first(Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE))
fun inArrayNull() = Api.inArray(arrayOf(Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE)))
fun inChoiceNull() = Api.inChoice(ChoiceEmpty())
fun inExceptNull() = Api.inExcept(Result.ok<Packet, Packet>(Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE)))
fun inHolderNull() = Api.inHolder(Holder(Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE), java.math.BigInteger.ONE))
fun inListNull() = Api.inList(arrayOf(Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE)))
fun inOptionNull() = Api.inOption(Option.some(Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE)))
fun inProductNull() = Api.inProduct(Pair(Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE), Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE)))
fun pairNull() = Api.pair(Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE), Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE))
fun secondNull() = Api.second(Packet(java.math.BigInteger.ONE, java.math.BigInteger.ONE))
